name: Hobbits
summary: Hobbits are an unobtrusive yet resilient race of small folk native to the Shire who are known for their love of peace, comfort, and good food.

name: Frodo Baggins
summary: A respectable and quiet young hobbit from the Shire who inherits a mysterious and highly dangerous magic ring from his uncle.

name: Aragorn II
summary: A mysterious, weather-beaten ranger of the wilderness who possesses a hidden royal lineage and great martial skill.

name: Samwise Gamgee
summary: A loyal and simple-hearted gardener of Bag End who accompanies his master, Frodo, on a perilous quest.

name: Legolas
summary: A highly skilled elven archer and the prince of the Elves of Mirkwood.

name: Gimli
summary: A proud and stalwart dwarf warrior from the Lonely Mountain who represents his people at the council in Rivendell.

name: Boromir
aliases: High Warden of the White Tower
summary: A valiant warrior and the eldest son of the Ruling Steward of Gondor, who travels north seeking aid for his besieged homeland.

name: Arwen
summary: The beautiful and noble half-elven daughter of Elrond, the Lord of Rivendell.

name: Théoden
summary: The aging King of Rohan who rules from the golden hall of Meduseld, currently beset by grief and ill advice.

name: Éowyn
summary: A noble shieldmaiden of Rohan and the spirited niece of King Théoden, who yearns to prove her courage in battle.

name: Faramir
aliases: Captain of the Rangers of Ithilien
summary: The thoughtful and scholarly younger brother of Boromir, who commands the rangers guarding the borders of Gondor.

name: Sauron
summary: An ancient and malevolent dark lord who seeks to reclaim his lost Ring of Power to subject the world to his dominion.

name: Gollum
summary: A wretched, obsessed creature who once possessed the Ring of Power and constantly stalks its new bearer to reclaim it.

name: Mordor
summary: Mordor is a desolate and menacing realm in the east of Middle-earth ruled by the Dark Lord Sauron.
